conclusion_zh: 真模型正确性及复用路径通过；本轮未证实稳定的端到端加速。差异低于同版本重复运行漂移，不建议按已证明收益的性能优化宣传或优先推进。

summary.claim_scope: small offline eager-mode pilot; descriptive only

correctness.rope_and_each_step_latents: bit exact across baseline/candidate and repetitions
correctness.full_size_rgb: bit exact across all arms for each matched sample

four_grid.省掉什么成本: 请求内重复生成 RoPE；4 步真模型检查中普通路径 4→1、CFG 路径 8→2。编辑输入的位置 ID 拼接也移至循环外。
four_grid.在什么条件下成立: 本轮单 H200、BF16、eager、SP=TP=1、无量化/offload/额外缓存；同一请求的位置 ID 不变。
four_grid.付出什么代价: 请求内持有 RoPE 张量至 pipeline 返回，增加临时存活内存；512² 文生图诊断峰值 allocated 增加 1.5 MiB，编辑诊断主峰未变。不能据此推断其他尺寸峰值。
four_grid.用什么对照验证: 固定源码差异、镜像、模型 revision、提示词和 seed；先真实中间结果检查，再同卡独立进程 ABBA；最终 latency 仅描述性差异，均小于 A/A 或 B/B 漂移。

cost.note: Additional CPU preparation, startup/cleanup, CPU bursts and retention are not captured by loop elapsed. No account credits assumed. Storage excluded.

failure_provenance.classification: harness startup probe bug, not model correctness failure
failure_provenance.detail: Probe assumed a request ID existed during framework initialization dummy run. Fixed by bypassing diagnostics during initialization and clearing case metadata before every fresh process.
